_about: ACME-PTS: fungible loyalty points (program `fungible`, standard UNITS-FT). Rename the ACME- prefix: class names are GLOBALLY unique across all tenants. `config.tokenClassId` is filled in from the register response `response.id`. Fungible classes keep ONE token per owner: repeat operator mints top up the same treasury token, and customers get their own token only by receiving a transfer. maxSupply is checked against the minting account's own token (a per-issuer cap; the class cap while you are the only issuer). No minBalance is set here; if you add one (even "0") with the min-balance hook, every burn and lock must carry `value` (whole-token locks fail). See references/token-classes.md 6.2 and token-programs.md 4.

register.name: ACME Loyalty Points
register.description: Fungible loyalty points issued by ACME. 2 decimals (1 point = 100 base units).

schema.description: Documentation only - UNITS does not enforce class schemas; the fungible program validates.
